list.emptyActiveText: Create a reminder with its own timer and active hours.
list.emptyArchiveText: Finished and archived events appear here.

form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: What should I remind you about?
form.timerHint: Fill only what you need. 1 month = 30 days.
form.repeatHint: Only Done counts. Snooze does not.
form.repeatArchiveHint: After the last Done the event moves to Archive.
form.onceHint: One reminder. After Done the event moves to Archive.
form.hoursInfo: Timers under 1 day pause outside these hours and restart from the full interval when hours begin. Timers of 1 day or more count calendar time; if one is due outside hours, it waits until the next start.

errors.empty: Set a timer: at least one field above 0.
errors.sameHours: Start and end of active hours are the same.
errors.longerThanWindow: A {{interval}} timer does not fit into {{hours}}. Timers under 1 day run only inside active hours — make the timer shorter or the hours longer.
errors.dataUnavailable: Your data could not be read, so nothing is saved. Use Retry at the top.
errors.categoryInUse: This category still has events. Move them to another category first.
errors.lastCategory: At least one category must stay.
errors.unknownCategory: This category no longer exists. Choose another one.
errors.categoryName: Enter a name up to 40 characters.
errors.soundSize: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.soundType: Use an MP3, WAV or OGG file.
errors.soundPlay: The sound could not be played.

settings.title: Settings
settings.opacityHint: Background only — text and buttons stay sharp.
settings.blurHint: While on, Reminder is hidden from screenshots and screen sharing.
settings.clickThroughInfo: Clicks pass through the window to what is behind it. To turn this off, right-click the Reminder icon in the tray and uncheck Click-through.
settings.startWithWindowsDev: Works in the installed app only.
settings.soundHint: MP3, WAV or OGG, up to 10 MB.

banner.title: Your data could not be read
banner.text: Nothing is saved until this is fixed. The file stays untouched.
banner.resetDone: The broken file was kept next to the new one.
